messages.message: hi i need help with my bill it's way too high this month!! 😡
Hello! Thanks for contacting Nimbus Telecom. I'm Sana. I'd be happy to help you with your billing concerns today. 😊
Before we dive into the account, could you please provide your account number and full name for verification?
Sure, it's Vivek Reddy and my account number is 32252095
Thank you, Mr. Reddy. I can see you're upset about the charges, and I completely understand why that would be frustrating. Let me check the details for you.
Yeah, there's a charge for a premium movie package I never even signed up for. It's ridiculous.
I see the charge here. It looks like a mistake on our end. I will raise a refund request for the wrong charge right now.
Thanks. Just to be sure, can you confirm my contact info? It's 96350 62306 and vivek.91@examplemail.com
Yes, that is correct. Please keep in mind that the refund is subject to approval and typically takes 7-10 business days to appear in your account.
Okay, that sounds fair. I appreciate you fixing this so quickly!
You're very welcome! Is there anything else I can assist you with today? I've submitted the request, so just keep an eye on your statement. Have a great day! 👋
